text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've come to the studio to 
accompany her for a pre-recording of a New 
Year's program.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The request was to photograph the close 
childhood friend duo, Kitasan Black and 
Satono Diamond, but—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
My, the two of you truly get along so 
well. You're completely in sync!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time to check their chemistry 
with our Compatibility Test corner!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Question 1! "You find a stray kitten. What 
would you do?!" Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Welcome it into the family! Look for a 
foster owner!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oops! We've already got a split on the 
very first question, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, Dia-chan, you don't keep any pets?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I thought it looked like fun, lounging 
around together or having them sit on your 
lap.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking keeping a pet isn't that 
simple. After all, while you're at the 
dorms, you wouldn't be able to take care 
of it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't a match, but moving on to 
question two! "While making a fried egg, 
the yolk breaks. What would you two do in 
this situation?!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: "Never mind that! Scrambled eggs it is!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I never thought of that! I figured 
since I'd just break it apart when eating 
anyway, it didn't really matter.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just like you, Kita-chan. 
Personally, I like scrambled eggs just as 
much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Our answers didn't match up, but 
doing this is pretty fun too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even as the questions continued, 
the two never gave the same answer—"

text_block_list.name: Show Staff Members
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, are they surprisingly not syncing 
up at all? Is this... gonna be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to wrap things up, we'll be 
moving over to our annual New Year's mochi 
pounding corner!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In honor of New Year's, they're taking on 
the mochi-pounding challenge, but will the 
two be able to synchronize their rhythm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having struggled with the compatibility 
test, an uneasy air lingers as to whether 
the two can pull this off, but—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, Dia-chan, are you ready? We're 
going all out from the start!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, Kita-chan! I'll stay right 
by your side!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well then—*ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes! For the New Year, I shall 
pound this mochi to pray for everyone's 
health and happiness!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho! ――Hup! ――Hup!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! What brilliant synergy! It's hard to 
believe they were butting heads just 
moments ago!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Pounding mochi with Dia-chan really 
brings back memories of New Year's at 
home."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
New Year's at Kita-chan's place is always 
so lively. Every year, all the apprentices 
gather together—

text_block_list.name: The Two in Their Childhood
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho! ――Hup! ――Hup!

text_block_list.name: Family Dojo Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, when it comes to pounding mochi, we 
really can't beat the older folks! Their 
timing is in perfect sync!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Dia-chan. You absolutely have to 
come over to our place this New Year's 
too, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's pound mochi together, and 
eat ozoni together too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the heartwarming, friendly dynamic 
typical of childhood friends brought 
smiles to the staff's faces as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's push through all in one go! 
Everyone, lend me your voices—ready, set, 
go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Filming Crew
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One more time, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd around her caught on to Kitasan 
Black's cheering chant, turning the 
photoshoot into a thoroughly festive 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've seen how perfectly in sync 
the two of you are, may I ask one last 
question?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"When the two of you eat mochi— what 
flavor is your go-to?!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Grated daikon radish! Sweet red bean 
mochi!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Kita-chan, when you were little, you 
always went for the ankoromochi, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe I've developed an adult's 
palate! Though of course, I love that too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural to have differing 
opinions. And that's precisely why Kitasan 
Black and Satono Diamond get along so 
well.
